name: openskin
description: An OpenCode-style transcript: prompts, tool calls and errors in barred blocks, Claude's replies on a background band with framed shell commands, and a '▣ Claude · model · duration' footer under each turn. The look and the command frames each have a switch; every color is an option.

opencodeStyle.title: OpenCode look
opencodeStyle.description: Draw prompts, tool calls and errors as barred blocks, Claude's replies on a background band, and the '▣ Claude · model · duration' footer. Off keeps Claude Code's own transcript.

commandFrames.title: Shell command frames
commandFrames.description: Frame the shell commands in Claude's replies and ask Claude to tag every command fence with its shell. Off leaves commands as plain code blocks.

statusPanel.title: Status line band
statusPanel.description: Redraw your status line script's output in a band above the prompt, refreshed when Claude Code runs the script. Off leaves the band to Claude Code.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: The bar beside your prompts and the square in the turn footer: a hex such as #f0a6ec, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key.

surface.title: Block background
surface.description: The background of the prompt, tool and error blocks: a hex such as #24242c, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key.

toolBar.title: Tool bar color
toolBar.description: The bar beside tool calls and their results: a hex such as #55555f, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key.

error.title: Error bar color
error.description: The bar beside error rows: a hex such as #ff6b5b, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key.

muted.title: Muted text color
muted.description: The model and duration in the turn footer, and the text of error rows: a hex such as #7f7f8a, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key.

command.title: Shell command frame color
command.description: The frame and label of the shell commands in Claude's replies: a hex such as #f0a6ec, a color name, or a Claude Code theme key such as bashBorder.

background.title: Reply background
background.description: The band drawn behind Claude's replies in the OpenCode look: a hex such as #1c1c22, a color name, a Claude Code theme key, or none for no background.
